en: Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a rural European village surrounded by rectangular crop fields and pastures. A cluster of farmhouses and barns sits among tree‑lined roads, with a small church or similar building visible in the distance. Curving country roads cross near the foreground where a few detached houses with gardens are located. The image has the framing and style typical of mid‑20th‑century landscape postcards.
